description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaFrameWriterV1 class, verifying its ability to write media frames (audio and video) into a shared memory buffer, including handling of buffer limits and multiple frames.

classes.name: RialtoPlayerCommonWriteFrameV1Test
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing MediaFrameWriterV1's frame writing capabilities, including setup and buffer validation methods.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes shared memory info and buffer before each test.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up allocated frames and resets the media frame writer after each test.

methods.name: AddAudioFrame
methods.description: Adds an audio frame to the test data vector with specified parameters.

methods.name: AddVideoFrame
methods.description: Adds a video frame to the test data vector with specified parameters.

methods.name: DeleteFrames
methods.description: Deletes all allocated frame data and clears the data vector.

methods.name: CheckSharedBuffer
methods.description: Validates that the shared memory buffer contains the expected metadata and data for each frame.

methods.name: readLEUint32
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit unsigned integer from a buffer.

methods.name: readLEInt64
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 64-bit signed integer from a buffer.
